notes: Triage of the top ~200 open stories by strength (of 814). 118 stories closed in fuse with a reason; every closure is in the skipped list. Left open on purpose: government-source stories, multi-publisher stories, ICS/critical-infrastructure items, claims against large companies and the Iran/tanker cluster. Not reached this run: the remaining ~600 lower-ranked stories (mostly single-source, score 5 and below); a later run should continue from list --limit 200 onward. Claims: the --claims filter showed the same top stories, so the 16 hidden leak-site claims were not individually reviewed. Dupes: DOJ crypto story and tanker story have related events on file with dupe score 0.57 (below the 1.0 duplicate threshold), so left open for the research loop.
